<style>
/* Base box style */
.box {
  position: absolute;
  width: 220px;
  padding: 16px;
  background-color: #e3f2fd;
  border-left: 5px solid #1565c0;
  border-radius: 10px;
  box-shadow: 3px 3px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2); /* general shadow */
  text-align: center;
  font-family: 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;
  font-size: 16px;
  color: #2c3e50;
}

/* Optional: stronger shadow only on the left border side */
.box::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  left: 0;
  top: 5px;
  bottom: 5px;
  width: 5px;
  background-color: inherit;
  box-shadow: 3px 0 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3); /* left-edge shadow */
  border-radius: 5px;
  z-index: -1;
}

/* Example: title node */
#eq {
  top: 80px;
  left: 400px;
  background-color: #fff8e1;
  border-left-color: #fbc02d;
  font-weight: bold;
  font-size: 18px;
}

/* Branches */
#n2 {
  top: 220px;
  left: 280px;
 background-color: #e8eaf6;
  border-left-color: #5c6bc0;
}

#n01 {
  top: 220px;
  left: 520px;
 background-color: #e8eaf6;
  border-left-color: #5c6bc0;
}

/* Methods */
#method1 {
  top: 340px;
  left: 260px;
  background-color: #e8eaf6;
  border-left-color: #5c6bc0;
  font-size: 14px;
}

#method2 {
  top: 340px;
  left: 500px;
  background-color: #e8eaf6;
  border-left-color: #5c6bc0;
  font-size: 14px;
}
</style>




<div id="eq" class="box">dy/dx + P(x)y = f(x)yⁿ</div>
<div id="n2" class="box">if n ≥ 2</div>
<div id="n01" class="box">if n = 0 or 1</div>
<div id="method1" class="box">Substitute u = y<sup>1–n</sup><br>Then I.F. method</div>
<div id="method2" class="box">Integrating Factor Method</div>

<script>
  window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
    new LeaderLine(
      document.getElementById('eq'),
      document.getElementById('n2'),
      { color: '#555', path: 'straight', size: 2 }
    );
    new LeaderLine(
      document.getElementById('eq'),
      document.getElementById('n01'),
      { color: '#555', path: 'straight', size: 2 }
    );
    new LeaderLine(
      document.getElementById('n2'),
      document.getElementById('method1'),
      { color: '#777', path: 'straight', size: 2 }
    );
    new LeaderLine(
      document.getElementById('n01'),
      document.getElementById('method2'),
      { color: '#777', path: 'straight', size: 2 }
    );
  });
</script>
